why: A choice the person makes for themselves is the dictionary (or ない) form plus ことにする; ことになる would mean someone else or circumstances decided it.

act: 毎朝[まいあさ]走[はし]る

keep a diary every day

en: It has been decided that <who> will <act>, starting <when>.
why: A decision made by the company or by circumstances, not by the person, is the dictionary form plus ことになる.
